voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: By nineteen ninety-three, so many people in Taos, New Mexico, had complained about a sound that their members of Congress asked for an investigation.
A low hum. A rumble. A drone. Only about two in every hundred people said they could hear it.
That summer, scientists from Sandia, Los Alamos, the Air Force and the University of New Mexico brought instruments to Taos to measure it.
Hearers matched its pitch: very low, between thirty and eighty hertz. The instruments never found the source.
Hums like it have been reported around the world. Most have never been traced.
